results.title: iPhone 17 Review: Entry-Level Model Is All You Need - CNET
results.content: # Never Mind the iPhone Pro: The iPhone 17 Is Probably All You Need. ## iPhone 17. **Editors' Note**: The iPhone 17 packs many of the same features you'll get on Apple's pricier Pro phones, and brings improvements to the camera, battery and display. For the past couple of weeks, I've been carrying two phones: the iPhone 17 and the iPhone Air. And while the latter has drummed up more fanfare among my curious friends and colleagues, it's the iPhone 17 that strikes me as the more all-encompassing device, ticking the key boxes without costing a fortune -- at least compared with the rest of Apple's new lineup. But, as per usual, the iPhone 17 packs a less powerful processor than its counterparts: an A19 chip, rather than the A19 Pro on the iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max. In my experience, that hasn't led to any noticeable differences in how videos or games look on the baseline 17 versus the iPhone Air. Benchmark tests for the CPU in Geekbench 6 place the iPhone 17 above the iPhone 16 Pro Max, as well as the full iPhone 15 lineup.

results.title: iPhone 17E Review: Pro Features, Affordable Price - CNET
results.content: # iPhone 17E Review: Magnetically Appealing (and Pink). Apple's new $599 budget phone offers a premium feel, complete with MagSafe compatibility and an A19 chip. ## Apple iPhone 17E. At last, Apple's $599 iPhone 17E brings MagSafe's magnetic technology to its lowest-priced handset. It starts with 256GB of storage, making that $599 price more enticing -- even if it's arguably pushing the limits of what's considered a "budget" phone. But the fact that I have to double-check whether I'm reaching for the iPhone 17E or the 17 is surely a good sign that the gap between the two is narrowing -- and in the right direction. A fixed 60Hz display also means there's no always-on display, so I can't quickly glance at the time or my notifications. The iPhone 17E's 6.1-inch display is just slightly smaller than the 6.3-inch display on the iPhone 17, a difference that's hardly noticeable.

results.title: iPhone 17 vs. iPhone 16: Should You Upgrade? - CNET
results.content: # iPhone 17 vs. Apple's iPhone 17 has a lot in common with last year's model, but there are notable improvements to the camera, display and battery. iPhone 17 vs iPhone 16. If you're looking to buy a new iPhone, you may be wondering whether to get the iPhone 17 or score a discount on last year's iPhone 16. The iPhone 17 starts at $829 -- or $799 with carrier activation -- the same price as the iPhone 16 when it debuted. But there's a key difference: The iPhone 17 starts with 256GB of storage, double the 128GB base on the iPhone 16. Apple says it shrunk the borders around the screen on the iPhone 17, expanding the display from 6.1 inches on the iPhone 16 to 6.3 inches on the iPhone 17 without expanding its dimensions. Both the iPhone 16 and 17 have a Camera Control button on the side to quickly launch the camera, snap some shots and use Apple's Visual Intelligence tool to learn more about what's around you.
